about.en: Eli Lilly xStock (LLYx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on Eli Lilly and Company shares, issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by LLY shares held with qualified custodians and tracks the share price on-chain on Solana (Xsnuv4omNoHozR6EEW5mXkw8Nrny5rB3jVfLqi6gKMH), Ethereum, BNB Chain and Arbitrum (0x19c41ea77b34bbdee61c3a87a75d1abda2ed0be4) and other networks. xStocks are offered to non-US investors and carry a claim to the value of the underlying stock, not the share itself.
